description: Get, set, or delete a single frontmatter key on a note, atomically. `set` requires a JSON-typed `value` (string, number, boolean, array, or object).

operation.description: Operation to perform on `key`. `get` — read the current value. `set` — write `value`, creating the key if absent. `delete` — remove the key from frontmatter.

oneOf.description: Address a note by its vault-relative path.
Address whichever file is currently active in the Obsidian UI.

type.description: Address the file currently open in Obsidian.

oneOf.description: Address a periodic note (current or dated).

date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the current period.

value.description: Required when `operation` is `"set"`. JSON-typed value to write — strings, numbers, booleans, arrays, and objects all accepted.

name: obsidian_manage_frontmatter

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `path_forbidden`: `get` requires the path to be readable; `set`/`delete` require it to be inside OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS, with OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY=false. `value_required`: `operation` is "set" but no `value` was supplied. `frontmatter_invalid`: `operation` is "delete" and the note's existing frontmatter does not parse as a mapping of properties, or removing the key would leave YAML that cannot be re-emitted (an alias whose anchor went with it). Nothing is written — the note keeps its original bytes. `note_missing`: The vault path does not resolve to an existing note. `no_active_file`: Target was `active` but no file is currently open in Obsidian. `periodic_unsupported`: Target was `periodic` and this vault runs Local REST API v5.0.2 or later without the companion periodic-notes extension, so the `/periodic/` routes are not served at all. `periodic_not_found`: Target was `periodic`, the `/periodic/` routes are served on this vault, and no note exists for the requested period. `periodic_disabled`: Target was `periodic` but the requested period is not enabled in Obsidian's Periodic Notes plugin settings. `path_is_directory`: The supplied path names a folder rather than a note file. `path_traversal`: The path contains a `.` or `..` segment, which is rejected to prevent vault escape. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

exists.description: True when the key was present in the frontmatter.

value.description: Current value, or `null` when the key is absent.

currentSizeInBytes.description: Byte size of the note after the set.

previousSizeInBytes.description: Byte size of the note before the set.

currentSizeInBytes.description: Byte size of the note after the delete. Equals `previousSizeInBytes` when the key was already absent and no write was issued.

previousSizeInBytes.description: Byte size of the note before the delete.
